case: Conditional mapping of legacy stop clamp supply onto servo converter output during 3S feedthrough fault
existing_connection: U10 TPS3808G01DBVR pins 5 and 6 connect to EFUSE_INPUT_5V; integration revA does not map this external net to either converter output
fault_voltage_basis: Selected 3S candidate at 4.2 V per cell; converter feedthrough is an existing fault scenario, not a claim that it occurs in normal operation
decision: Reject direct unprotected mapping; provide independently protected supply or replace with suitable wider-voltage stop architecture
